description: This file implements a shell interface for Git commands, including command parsing, execution, and an interactive shell environment, specifically for a restricted git-shell setup.

methods.name: do_generic_cmd
methods.description: Handles execution of generic git commands by preparing arguments and invoking execv_git_cmd.

methods.name: is_valid_cmd_name
methods.description: Checks if a command name contains no '.' or '/' characters, validating command format.

methods.name: make_cmd
methods.description: Constructs a command path string within the git-shell-commands directory.

methods.name: cd_to_homedir
methods.description: Changes current directory to the user's home directory based on HOME environment variable.

methods.name: run_shell
methods.description: Runs an interactive git shell, handling command input, execution, and special commands like quit or logout.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the git-shell program, handling command-line arguments, command dispatch, and interactive mode.
